title: "01_ca_create_typology"
author: Jenny Rempel
output: html_document

# Script overview: 
This script creates the typology of water systems described in the manuscript. It also creates Tables S1 and S2.

# Inputs:
- "raw_data/ca_boundaries_072325/California_Drinking_Water_System_Area_Boundaries.geojson" (CA SWRCB system boundary data downloaded July 23, 2025 from the CA State Geoportal; https://gis.data.ca.gov/datasets/waterboards::california-drinking-water-system-area-boundaries/about)

- "raw_data/Prison_Boundaries.geojson" (HIFLD prison boundaries dataset downloaded April 30, 2025, from https://hifld-geoplatform.hub.arcgis.com/datasets/geoplatform::prison-boundaries-1/explore?location=0.000000%2C-10.417157%2C0.00&showTable=true)

- "raw_data/SDWA_latest_downloads/SDWA_PUB_WATER_SYSTEMS.csv" (Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) public water system file downloaded 1/17/25 from USEPA SDWIS/ECHO: https://echo.epa.gov/files/echodownloads/SDWA_latest_downloads.zip downloaded from https://echo.epa.gov/tools/data-downloads; data download summary: https://echo.epa.gov/tools/data-downloads/sdwa-download-summary; date data extracted: 1/11/2025 noted on https://echo.epa.gov/resources/echo-data/about-the-data)

- "intermediate_data/updated_HIFLD_list_with_closures.xlsx" (created by research team)

- "intermediate_data/closest_pws_w_name_assigned_final.xlsx" (created by research team)

- "intermediate_data/multimatch_manual_check_assigned_final.xlsx" (created by research team)

# Key outputs:
- "processed_data/universe_pwsids.rds" (used in script 02)

- "processed_data/typology.rds" (used in script 02)

- "outputs/tbl_s1.rds" (used in script 06)

- "processed_data/prisons_ca_flat.rds" (used in script 06)

# Requires:
- pacman, tidyverse, janitor, sf, lubridate, mapview, readxl


# step 0. Setup (always run these)
```{r}
# Install pacman if not present
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")

# Check, install missing, and load all packages in one call
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, # general purpose
               janitor,#  tidying dataframes
               sf, # spatial work
               lubridate, # dates
               mapview,# mapping
               readxl) # read excel files

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r useful functions}

# %notin%: operator that returns the negation of %in%
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

# count_df_na: takes a dataframe and returns counts of NA values in each column
count_df_na <- function(df) {
  sapply(df, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
}

# view_flat: quick look at sf objects w/o geometry
view_flat <- function(df) {
  st_drop_geometry(df) %>% 
    View()
}

```



# step 1. spatial intersection
## 1a. prep datasets
```{r}
###
# load
### 

# ca pws service area boundaries - downloaded 7/23/25
ca_sabl <- read_sf("raw_data/ca_boundaries_072325/California_Drinking_Water_System_Area_Boundaries.geojson")
dim(ca_sabl) # 4804   35

# hifld carceral facility boundaries - downloaded January 17, 2025 from
# https://hifld-geoplatform.hub.arcgis.com/datasets/geoplatform::prison-boundaries-1/explore?location=0.000000%2C-10.417157%2C0.00&showTable=true 
prisons_all_raw <- sf::read_sf("raw_data/Prison_Boundaries.geojson") 
dim(prisons_all_raw) # 6468. 27


###
# clean and filter PWSs
### 

# clean
ca_sabl_c <- ca_sabl %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

# are they all active?
table(ca_sabl_c$activity_status_cd) # all active

# what classifications?
table(ca_sabl_c$federal_classification, ca_sabl_c$state_classification) 
  # one looks odd; others make sense 

# look at that system
ca_sabl_c %>% filter(federal_classification == "NON-PUBLIC" & 
                       state_classification == "COMMUNITY") 
  # we'll keep it as a CWS

# quick look on map
#ca_sabl_c_s <- ca_sabl_c %>% 
#  dplyr::select(water_system_name, county, population, 
#                federal_classification,state_classification)
#mapview(ca_sabl_c_s)

# quick look on map at non-cws
#ca_sabl_c_non_cws <- ca_sabl_c %>% 
#  dplyr::select(water_system_name, county, population, 
#                federal_classification,state_classification) %>% 
#  dplyr::filter(federal_classification != "COMMUNITY")
#mapview(ca_sabl_c_non_cws)

# filter to possible system types
ca_sabl_public <- ca_sabl_c %>% 
  filter(state_classification %in% c("COMMUNITY", "NON-TRANSIENT NON-COMMUNITY",
                                     # here we include TNC just in case; 
                                     # ultimately no carceral facilities join to TNC systems
                                     "TRANSIENT NON-COMMUNITY"))
  # alternatively, can exclude: 
  # c("NON-PUBLIC", "Recycled Water", "LOCAL STATE SMALL SYSTEM", "STATE SMALL WATER SYSTEM")
  
nrow(ca_sabl_public) # 4725

# how many have been verified by the CA SWRCB?
table(ca_sabl_public$verified_status)
  # 2605 not verified; 2062 verified; 58 pending
  # note: there are some duplicates (e.g. jurisdictional, boundary)

# make sure that looks good
#table(ca_sabl_public$state_classification) # good: CWS, NTNC, TNC
#table(ca_sabl_public$federal_classification) # hm, what are the non-publics?
# check that
#chk <- ca_sabl_public %>% filter(federal_classification == "NON-PUBLIC") 
#view_flat(chk) # 3 TNC; 1 CWS; none of these ultimately join to carceral facilities


### 
# clean & filter to appropriate carceral facilities
###

# clean
prisons_all <- prisons_all_raw %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()
  
# select open facilities in CA
prisons_ca <- prisons_all %>%
  filter(status == "OPEN", state == "CA") 
nrow(prisons_ca) # 357

# make flat version for any manual analyses
prisons_ca_flat <- prisons_ca %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()
write_csv(prisons_ca_flat, "processed_data/prisons_ca_flat.csv")
saveRDS(prisons_ca_flat, "processed_data/prisons_ca_flat.rds")


###
# save
###

saveRDS(ca_sabl_public, "processed_data/ca_sabl_public.rds")
saveRDS(prisons_ca, "processed_data/prisons_ca.rds")

# for double checking analysis in ArcGIS, save copy w/ updated column names
ca_sabl_arc <- ca_sabl
ca_sabl_arc <- ca_sabl_arc %>% 
  rename(pwsid_numb = WATER_SYSTEM_NUMBER,
         wat_sys_name = WATER_SYSTEM_NAME,
         address1 = ADDR_LINE_ONE_TXT,
         address2 = ADDR_LINE_TWO_TXT) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c("LAST_EDITED_USER","LAST_EDITED_DATE"))
names(ca_sabl_arc) <- substr(names(ca_sabl_arc), 1, 10) # keep first 10 characters

st_write(ca_sabl_arc, "processed_data/ca_sabl_arc.shp", delete_layer = TRUE)
  # some shape_area warnings but not using that field

```
At this point, the team manually identified 9 facilities listed as open that had in fact closed.

## 1b. filter prisons and perform spatial intersection
```{r}

###
# load
###

ca_sabl_public <- readRDS("processed_data/ca_sabl_public.rds")
prisons_ca <- readRDS("processed_data/prisons_ca.rds")

# closed facilities - created by team
closed_facilities <- read_xlsx("intermediate_data/updated_HIFLD_list_with_closures.xlsx")

# remove 9 closed systems (identified manually by team)
prisons_ca_open <- prisons_ca %>% 
  filter(facilityid %notin% closed_facilities$FACILITYID)

nrow(prisons_ca) # 357
nrow(prisons_ca_open) # 348
nrow(prisons_ca) - nrow(prisons_ca_open) # 9, good


###
# prep for, perform, and assess spatial intersection
###

# check CRSs
st_crs(prisons_ca_open) # epsg 4326, WGS84  
st_crs(prisons_ca_open)$IsGeographic # true (i.e., in degrees, needs to be transformed)
st_crs(ca_sabl_public) == st_crs(prisons_ca_open) 
  # both need to be transformed to a projected crs

# transform
prisons_t <- st_transform(prisons_ca_open, crs = "EPSG:3310")
ca_sabl_t <- st_transform(ca_sabl_public, crs = "EPSG:3310")

# 
nrow(prisons_t) # 348
nrow(ca_sabl_t) # 4725; includes some duplicates

# simple intersection
prisons_pws_intersection <- st_intersection(x = prisons_t,
                                            y = ca_sabl_t)
glimpse(prisons_pws_intersection)

# how many facilities match to 1 (or 0), 2, or 3 PWSs?
# count # matched
count_ca <- prisons_pws_intersection %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(facilityid) %>% 
  count()
table(count_ca$n)

# save single intersections (i.e. exactly one carceral facility & 1 PWS)
prisons_pws_intersection_single <- prisons_pws_intersection %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(facilityid) %>% 
  mutate(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(n == 1)
nrow(prisons_pws_intersection_single) # 265 facilities match to exactly 1 PWS

# save list of facilities that did not intersect with any PWS
no_match_ca <- prisons_t %>% 
  filter(facilityid %notin% count_ca$facilityid)
nrow(no_match_ca) # 46

# so: 
# 46 facilities intersect with 0 PWSs
# 265 facilities intersect with exactly 1 PWS
# 36 facilities intersect with 2 PWSs
# 1 facility intersects with 3 PWSs
46+265+36+1 # 348, good
46+265+36+1  == nrow(prisons_t) # true

# save list of facilities that intersect 2-3 PWSs
multimatch_ids <- count_ca %>% 
  filter(n>1)
nrow(multimatch_ids) # 37, good
multimatch_ca <- prisons_t %>% 
  filter(facilityid %in% multimatch_ids$facilityid)
nrow(multimatch_ca) # 37

# save list of facilities that intersect exactly 1 PWS
singlematch_ids <- count_ca %>% 
  filter(n == 1) 
singlematch_ca <- prisons_t %>% 
  filter(facilityid %in% singlematch_ids$facilityid)
nrow(singlematch_ca) # 265

## map

# simplify for mapping (can skip)
#pws_simple <- ca_sabl_t %>% 
#  dplyr::select(water_system_name, sabl_pwsid,
#                county, population, 
#                federal_classification, state_classification)

multimatch_ca_simple <- multimatch_ca %>%
```

Note: At this point, multimatch and non-match facilities were manually examined to identify the PWS. 

# step 2. finalize prison status dataset

## 2a. finalize list of water systems serving carceral facilities
```{r}
# load lists
nomatch <- read_xlsx("intermediate_data/closest_pws_w_name_assigned_final.xlsx")
multimatch <- read_xlsx("intermediate_data/multimatch_manual_check_assigned_final.xlsx")
prisons_pws_intersection <- readRDS("processed_data/prisons_pws_intersection_single.rds")
prisons_ca_open <- readRDS("processed_data/prisons_ca_open.rds")

# load list of cws's from institutional analysis (for exclusive carceral list)
cws_list <- read_csv("raw_data/ca_institutional_type/FINAL 2023 Inst. type update.csv")
nrow(cws_list) # 2967

# load ca-sabl boundaries and prison locations (for diagnosing one system)
ca_sabl_t <- readRDS("processed_data/ca_sabl_t.rds")
prisons_t <- readRDS("processed_data/prisons_t.rds")

###
# make list of carceral facilities and associated cws
###

# simplify each list to select pwsid & carceral facility name or ID
nomatch_joined <- nomatch %>% 
  dplyr::select(PWSID, facility_name)

multimatch_joined <- multimatch %>% 
  dplyr::select(PWSID, facility_name)

prisons_pws_intersection_joined <- prisons_pws_intersection %>% 
  dplyr::select(facilityid, sabl_pwsid)

## join those matched list to the full prison data (to add back details)
# simplify
prisons_simple <- prisons_ca_open %>% 
  dplyr::select(facilityid, name)

# join
nomatch_joined2 <- nomatch_joined %>% 
  left_join(prisons_simple, by = c("facility_name" = "name")) %>% 
  mutate(match_method = "nomatch_manual_assign")
nrow(nomatch_joined2) == nrow(nomatch) # true
nrow(nomatch_joined2) # 27, good
#glimpse(nomatch_joined2)

multimatch_joined2 <- multimatch_joined %>% 
  left_join(prisons_simple, by = c("facility_name" = "name")) %>% 
  mutate(match_method = "multimatch_manual_assign")
nrow(multimatch_joined2) == nrow(multimatch) # true
nrow(multimatch_joined2) # 35, good
#glimpse(multimatch_joined2)

prisons_pws_intersection_joined2 <- prisons_pws_intersection_joined %>% 
  left_join(prisons_simple, by = "facilityid") %>% 
  rename(PWSID = sabl_pwsid,
         facility_name = name) %>% 
  relocate(PWSID, facility_name, facilityid) %>% 
  mutate(match_method = "spatial_intersection")
nrow(prisons_pws_intersection_joined2) # 265
#glimpse(prisons_pws_intersection_joined2)

names(nomatch_joined2) == names(multimatch_joined2)  # true
names(multimatch_joined2)  == names(prisons_pws_intersection_joined2) # true

all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial <- prisons_pws_intersection_joined2 %>% 
  bind_rows(nomatch_joined2) %>% 
  bind_rows(multimatch_joined2) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  st_drop_geometry()

nrow(multimatch_joined2) + nrow(nomatch_joined2) + nrow(prisons_pws_intersection_joined2) == nrow(all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial) # true
table(all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial$match_method)

# find the unmatched ones
prisons_missing_pwsid <- prisons_ca_open %>% 
  filter(facilityid %notin% all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial$facilityid) %>% 
  mutate(PWSID = "not_matched",
         match_method = "not_matched") %>% 
  rename(facility_name = name) %>% 
  dplyr::select(PWSID, facility_name, facilityid, match_method) %>% 
  # leave here for ordering
  st_drop_geometry()
nrow(prisons_missing_pwsid) # 21

# manually remove the one we identified has closed
prisons_missing_pwsid2 <- prisons_missing_pwsid %>% 
  filter(facilityid != "10006705")
nrow(prisons_missing_pwsid2) # 20, as expected

# check
nrow(prisons_ca_open) == nrow(all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial) + nrow(prisons_missing_pwsid2) + 1 # true (+1 is for the facility we identified has closed)

# join
all_prisons_w_pwsid_status <- prisons_missing_pwsid2 %>% 
  bind_rows(all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial)
nrow(all_prisons_w_pwsid_status) + 1 == nrow(prisons_ca_open) # true
  # (+1 is for the facility we identified has closed)
table(all_prisons_w_pwsid_status$match_method) # 20 not matched

# save
write_csv(all_prisons_w_pwsid_status, "outputs/all_prisons_w_pwsid_status.csv")
saveRDS(all_prisons_w_pwsid_status, "processed_data/all_prisons_w_pwsid_status.rds")
write_csv(prisons_missing_pwsid2, "outputs/unmatched_facilities.csv")


###
# identify CWS by carceral facility status
###

# clean the list of exclusive carceral systems
cws_list_c <- cws_list %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

# filter the dryad list for appropriate systems
cws_list_carceral <- cws_list_c %>% 
  filter(inst_subtype == "Carceral")
nrow(cws_list_carceral) # 45

## first, check that the same system was assigned via dryad and spatial analysis
#view(cws_list_carceral)


## now, remove exclusive carceral systems from the non-exclusive (i.e. spatial-join) list
pws_carceral_nonexclusive <- all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial %>% 
  rename(pwsid = PWSID) %>% 
  filter(pwsid %notin% cws_list_carceral$pwsid)

## checks
length(cws_list_carceral$pwsid) # 45 PWSs on dryad list
length(unique(all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial$PWSID)) 
  # 208 PWSs on initial list (incl both exclusive & non-exclusive carceral facilities)
length(unique(all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial$facilityid)) 
  # 327 facilities on initial list

length(unique(pws_carceral_nonexclusive$pwsid)) 
  # 165 PWSs on subsequent list (i.e. non-exclusive carceral PWSs)
length(unique(pws_carceral_nonexclusive$facilityid)) 
  # 268 facilities on subsequent list (i.e. served by non-exclusive carceral PWSs)

208-165 # 43 PWSs matched to carceral facilities via both Dryad list and spatial analysis
327-268 # 59 facilities matched to PWSs via both Dryad list and spatial analysis

# table of match method for initial list (incl both exclusive & non-exclusive carceral facilities)
table(all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial$match_method)

# table of match method for filtered nonexclusive list
table(pws_carceral_nonexclusive$match_method)

# which 2 PWSs were on Dryad list but not identified via spatial analysis?
cws_list_carceral_chk <- cws_list_carceral %>% 
  filter(pwsid %notin% all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial$PWSID)

print(cws_list_carceral_chk)
  # 1 facility (pilot rock) has since closed
  # gilbert street complex - need to check

# look at gilbert on map
gilbert <- ca_sabl_t %>% 
  filter(sabl_pwsid == "CA3600215")

# map
#mapview(gilbert) + 
#  mapview(prisons_t)

# it looks like the CWS service area boundary is inaccurately drawn
# reassign to this CWS:
  # facilityid 10005329, CENTRAL VALLEY JUVENILE DETENTION AND ASSESSMENT CENTER
  # facilityid 10005330, REGIONAL YOUTH EDUCATIONAL FACILITY (previously assigned CA3610039)
  # the address listed indicates gilbert street, not the address where the PWS
  # service area boundary is drawn, and it is unconfirmed.
  # Therefore, we will manually reassign these 2 facilities

#view_flat(all_prisons_w_pwsid_info_from_spatial)
  # both were previously assigned CA3610039 (city of san bernardino) via spatial analysis


# next, look at pilot rock on map
pilot_rock <- ca_sabl_t %>% 
  filter(sabl_pwsid == "CA3610801")

# map
#mapview(pilot_rock) + 
#  mapview(prisons_t)
  # from google maps, perhaps it is serving the fire center that's still there

# is there another pws nearby that would be serving the remaining facilities?
sb <- ca_sabl_t %>% 
  filter(county == "SAN BERNARDINO")

# map
#mapview(pilot_rock) + 
#  mapview(sb)
  # Clawa CWS (CA3610114) overlaps and its service area is listed as verified by CA SWRCB DDW
  # Clawa is a residential + wholesale CWS.
  # It's possible that Clawa provides water to the now non-carceral fire facilities at 
  # the Pilot Rock Fire Center.
  # Either way, because the Conservation Camp has closed, we list the Pilot Rock
  # CWS (CA3610801) as non-carceral now.


# manually reassign exclusive carceral systems
cws_list_exclusive_carceral_near_final <- cws_list_carceral %>% 
  # remove pilot rock from this list
  filter(pwsid != "CA3600215") %>% 
  # remove gilbert street complex from this list
  filter(pwsid != "CA3610801")
nrow(cws_list_exclusive_carceral_near_final) # 43, good 

# manually reassign 2 facilities matched via spatial analysis to gilbert street
pws_carceral_nonexclusive_near_final <- pws_carceral_nonexclusive %>% 
  mutate(pwsid = ifelse(facilityid %in% c("10005329", "10005330"),
                        "CA3600215", pwsid))
length(unique(pws_carceral_nonexclusive$pwsid)) # 165
length(unique(pws_carceral_nonexclusive_near_final$pwsid)) #166 
  # number of PWSs goes up by one bc City of San Bernardino is still identified
  # as serving one other carceral facility, and CA3600215 (Gilbert St) is now added
  # to this list.

### 
# last step: manually reassign some PWSs as exclusively carceral PWSs
###

# at this point, we manually reviewed the list of non-exclusive carceral PWSs 
# to see if any of them were in fact better characterized as exclusively carceral.
# I manually reassign these here.

## adjust the nonexclusive list
pws_carceral_nonexclusive_final <- pws_carceral_nonexclusive_near_final %>% 
  # remove the PWS serving LOS PRIETOS BOYS CAMP (facility id: 10006710), which
  # we previously identified had closed,
  # and is thus placed on the 'other water systems' (non-carceral) list
  filter(pwsid != "CA4200918") %>%
   # remove the PWS serving Valley View (facility id: 10005275), which seems to have closed
```

## 2b.i. add universe of all systems
```{r}

###
# load
###

# lists
pws_carceral_nonexclusive_final_ids <- readRDS("processed_data/pws_carceral_nonexclusive_final_ids.rds")

cws_list_exclusive_carceral_final <- readRDS("processed_data/cws_list_exclusive_carceral_final.rds")

carceral_sys_ids <- readRDS("processed_data/carceral_sys_ids.rds")

# usepa sdwis (echo data)
pws_list <- read_csv("raw_data/SDWA_latest_downloads/SDWA_PUB_WATER_SYSTEMS.csv")
nrow(pws_list) # 431754


###
# clean ECHO for relevant systems (CWS and NTNC)
###

# clean echo data
pws_list_cl <- pws_list %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  mutate(pws_deactivation_date_2 =
           lubridate::mdy(pws_deactivation_date),
         first_reported_date_2 =
           lubridate::mdy(first_reported_date)) %>% 
  relocate(pwsid, pws_deactivation_date, pws_deactivation_date_2,
           first_reported_date, first_reported_date_2)
nrow(pws_list_cl) # 431754

## inspect data
# confirm pwsid is unique
length(unique(pws_list_cl$pwsid)) == nrow(pws_list_cl) # true, good
table(pws_list_cl$submissionyearquarter) # all Q4 2024, good

## filtering by pws type
# look at pws type
table(pws_list_cl$pws_type_code) 

# filter for CWSs and NTNCs
cws_and_ntnc <- pws_list_cl %>% 
  filter(pws_type_code %in% c("CWS", "NTNCWS"))
nrow(cws_and_ntnc) # 145752

# filter for CA systems
cws_and_ntnc_ca <- cws_and_ntnc %>% 
  filter(primacy_agency_code == "CA")
nrow(cws_and_ntnc_ca) # 8613, good 

# save for next step
saveRDS(cws_and_ntnc_ca, "intermediate_data/cws_and_ntnc_ca.rds")

## are we overlooking any systems based on missing or incorrect data?
# look at na's
count_df_na(cws_and_ntnc_ca)
nrow(cws_and_ntnc_ca)

# look at date
min(cws_and_ntnc_ca$first_reported_date_2, na.rm = TRUE) # 1979
max(cws_and_ntnc_ca$first_reported_date_2, na.rm = TRUE) # 2024
min(cws_and_ntnc_ca$pws_deactivation_date_2, na.rm = TRUE) # 1980
max(cws_and_ntnc_ca$pws_deactivation_date_2, na.rm = TRUE) # 2024

# add variable for time bw first reported and deactivated date
cws_and_ntnc_time <- cws_and_ntnc_ca %>% 
  mutate(time_open = pws_deactivation_date_2 - first_reported_date_2)

# how many have dates that indicate a negative time open?
cws_and_ntnc_time %>% filter(time_open < 0) %>% nrow() # 107 systems
nrow(cws_and_ntnc_time) # 8613
107/8613

# simplify to check those systems
ca_sm <- cws_and_ntnc_time %>% 
  dplyr::select(pwsid,
                #first_reported_date,
                first_reported_date_2,
                #pws_deactivation_date,
                pws_deactivation_date_2,
                time_open,
                pws_activity_code, 
                pws_type_code,
                pws_name)
chk_time_open <- ca_sm %>% filter(time_open < 0) 
table(chk_time_open$pws_activity_code) # they're all inactive or N (changed), 
  # so will be excluded anyway
    # for reference:
    # A - Active
    # I - Inactive
    # N - Changed from public to non-public
    # M - Merged with another system
    # P - Potential future system to be regulated

# how many systems are new after 01-01-2020?
cws_and_ntnc_time %>% filter(first_reported_date_2 >= "2020-01-01") %>% nrow()
  # 87
chk_recent <- cws_and_ntnc_time %>% filter(first_reported_date_2 >= "2020-01-01") 

table(chk_recent$pws_activity_code) # 67 active


## filtering by date and activity code
# filter for systems active during our time frame
active_cws_ntnc <- cws_and_ntnc_time %>% 
  # active as of Q4-2024
  filter(pws_activity_code == "A") 
# how many unique systems?
nrow(active_cws_ntnc) # 4301

# check for recently closed systems just to note it
recently_closed <- cws_and_ntnc_time %>% 
  #  deactivation date after 2020 (i.e. they were open for part of 2020-2024)
  filter(pws_deactivation_date_2 >= "2020-01-01")
table(recently_closed$pws_activity_code)
  # 63 inactive, 159 changed from public to non-public

# do any of the systems in this dataset have a negative 'time open'?
negative_time <- active_cws_ntnc %>% 
  filter(time_open < 1) %>% nrow() # 0, so no

# how many were open for less than 1 year?
one_year <- active_cws_ntnc %>% 
  filter(time_open < 365 & time_open >= 1) %>% 
  dplyr::select(pwsid,
                #first_reported_date,
                first_reported_date_2,
                #pws_deactivation_date,
                pws_deactivation_date_2,
                time_open,
                pws_activity_code, 
                pws_type_code,
                pws_name)
nrow(one_year) # 0, none were open for less than a year

# rename for ease
active_cws_ntnc_echo <- active_cws_ntnc %>% 
  # add _echo to all variables so i know which dataset each variable comes from
  rename_with(~ paste(., "echo", sep= "_"))
nrow(active_cws_ntnc_echo) # 4301

###
# check that all carceral systems are in this list
###

chk_all_here <- as.data.frame(carceral_sys_ids) %>% 
  filter(carceral_sys_ids %notin% active_cws_ntnc_echo$pwsid_echo)
nrow(chk_all_here) # 0, good!

# check the inverse just in case
active_cws_ntnc_echo %>% 
  filter(pwsid_echo %in% carceral_sys_ids) %>% nrow() # 207
length(carceral_sys_ids) # 207, good


###
# identify water system within carceral typology
###

typology <- active_cws_ntnc_echo %>% 
  mutate(carceral_sys = 
           ifelse(pwsid_echo %in% cws_list_exclusive_carceral_final$pwsid, 
                  "carceral_water_system",
                  ifelse(pwsid_echo %in%
                           pws_carceral_nonexclusive_final_ids$pwsid, 
                         "carceral_serving_water_system",
                         "other_water_systems")))

table(typology$carceral_sys)

# save the universe of pwsids
universe_pwsids <- typology$pwsid_echo


###
# save
###

saveRDS(typology, "processed_data/typology.rds")
dim(typology) # 4301   55

saveRDS(active_cws_ntnc_echo, "processed_data/active_cws_ntnc_echo.rds")
dim(active_cws_ntnc_echo) # 4301   54
```

# step 3: make tables S1 and S2
```{r}
### 
# load
### 

# load carceral facilities & associated pwsids (noting that this list does not 
# adjust for several that we manually corrected later outside of this workflow,
# so some additional manual edits happen below)
all_prisons_w_pwsid_status <- readRDS("processed_data/all_prisons_w_pwsid_status.rds")

# load USEPA list of all water systems for water system info (address, city)
cws_and_ntnc_ca <- readRDS("intermediate_data/cws_and_ntnc_ca.rds")

# full prisons data - to include address/city
prisons_ca_flat <- readRDS("processed_data/prisons_ca_flat.rds")


### 
# simplify
###

all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s <- all_prisons_w_pwsid_status %>% 
  # remove unneeded column (it wasn't a spatial object anyways)
  dplyr::select(-geometry)

cws_and_ntnc_ca_s <- cws_and_ntnc_ca %>% 
  dplyr::select(pwsid, pws_name, address_line1,
                address_line2, city_name, zip_code)

prisons_ca_flat_s <- prisons_ca_flat %>% 
  dplyr::select(facilityid, name, type, 
                address, city, state, zip, 
                county)

###
# make manual update (to parallel what's above)
###

# manually change facilityid 10005329 and 10005330 to CWS CA3600215, based
# on Dryad/KBD list and manual review
all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s$PWSID[all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s$facilityid=="10005329"] <- "CA3600215"
all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s$match_method[all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s$facilityid=="10005329"] <- "subsequent_manual_assign"

all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s$PWSID[all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s$facilityid=="10005330"] <- "CA3600215"
all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s$match_method[all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s$facilityid=="10005330"] <- "subsequent_manual_assign"
  
# manually remove a facility that had closed and was removed earlier 
# (with PWS as unit of analysis)
# but leftover in the version with facility as unit of observation
all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s <- all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s %>% 
  filter(facility_name != "LOS PRIETOS BOYS CAMP") %>% 
  filter(facility_name != "VALLEY VIEW CONSERVATION CAMP #34")

nrow(all_prisons_w_pwsid_status) # 347
nrow(all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s) # 345, good


###
# join
###

# with facility as unit of observation, add additional info
all_prisons_w_pwsid_details <- all_prisons_w_pwsid_status_s %>% 
  # add pws address/city
  left_join(cws_and_ntnc_ca_s, by = c("PWSID" = "pwsid")) %>% 
  # add facility address/city
  left_join(prisons_ca_flat_s, by = ("facilityid"))

# double check
identical(all_prisons_w_pwsid_details$facility_name,
          all_prisons_w_pwsid_details$name) # true
nrow(all_prisons_w_pwsid_details) # 345, good

# select appropriate columns
final_list_tbl_s2 <- all_prisons_w_pwsid_details %>% 
  dplyr::select(-name) %>% 
  relocate(facility_name, facilityid, type, address, city, state, zip, county,
           match_method, PWSID, pws_name, address_line1, address_line2, 
           city_name, zip_code) %>% 
  rename(pwsid = PWSID)


# rename
tbl_s2 <- final_list_tbl_s2 %>% 
  dplyr::select(-state) %>% 
  # rename
  rename(facility_address = address,
         facility_city = city,
         facility_zip = zip,
         facility_county=county,
         pws_address_line1 = address_line1,
         pws_address_line2 = address_line2,
         pws_city = city_name,
         pws_zip = zip_code,
         match_method_wo_dryad = match_method)

# simpler version
tbl_s2_simple <- tbl_s2 %>% 
  dplyr::select(facility_name, type, facility_county, pwsid, pws_name)
  
# dbl chk
tbl_s2 %>% distinct(pws_name) %>% nrow()
# 208 bc one is NA, good

tbl_s2 %>% distinct(pwsid) %>% nrow()
# 208 bc one is NA, good

nrow(tbl_s2_simple) # 345 facilities, good


###
# last check in GIS software
###

prisons_ca <- readRDS("processed_data/prisons_ca.rds")
nrow(prisons_ca) # 357

prisons_sf <- prisons_ca %>%

prisons_sf_w_pwsid <- prisons_sf %>%

# add a flag if city names are not the same
```
